title: a person outside an open market joins its waitlist

criteria.text: Every US zip resolves to a market before launch; nothing is selected from a list
criteria.note: Restated 2026-10-11 (F103). `zip_county` and `counties` hold the national Census ZCTA table; `zip_market_key()` resolves a zip, a county no market names is its own waiting market; Connecticut's 288 zips landed in #959 (#905) [V migrations]. Checked: `[guards F076.1]` in `tests/f076-every-zip-market-db.test.ts` (#907), seen failing on main (CT missing) and against three mutants [V PR body]. Nothing merged for it since 2026-10-23 [V git log]. Reviewed no: #709 review-skipped, #907 and #959 carry no first-pass `Reviewed by:` [V]. Shipped: Deploy health green on 4f571f5c, 4f691c01, 8659ee4a [V]. Smoked: run 39291029395 (2026-10-19, main cd913c7d, after #959) opened join and onboarding, green; run 41328585318 (2026-11-01, main 3df92600, 51 passed) opened join and onboarding again, green, and the daily runs since cover root and explore [V smoke-live.yml]. #843 closed 2026-10-18. Rechecked 2026-11-27 [V]: unchanged since; earlier recheck 2026-11-20: `[guards F076.1]` still in `tests/f076-every-zip-market-db.test.ts`; #1313 and #1314 take the zip through the same `zip_market_key()`. The last green run covering join and onboarding is 41328585318 (2026-11-01); the 11-18 and 11-19 runs covered explore, page and you only.

criteria.text: The platform never selects a market for the person: no IP, default, nearest match or shortlist; the zip decides
criteria.note: `[guards F076.2]` in `tests/f076-never-rules.test.ts` scans the waitlist, onboarding and explore surfaces for IP, geolocation, distance and pre-checked controls [V]. No IP guess in src; `explore_vantage` reads the member's own zip inside the database (#932) [V]. Reviewed no (#709 review-skipped). Shipped yes (4f571f5c). Smoked: join and onboarding green on 2026-11-01 (run 41328585318, main 3df92600), explore green on 2026-11-04 (run 41884400137, main 49f942f0); explore is green again on 2026-11-19 (run 44594715209, main 05178eab) [V]; the journey's zip step reads the zip's market only (#1313) [V]. Rechecked 2026-11-27 [V]: #1484 (2026-11-26, F081 ruling 2026-11-25) reads Vercel's city-level IP guess in `src/lib/geo/ip-location.ts` and `src/app/explore/load.ts` to admit a signed-out visitor to an open market within an hour; it never picks a waitlist: beyond every open market the visitor sees 'not open near you yet' and Choose your area (`BrowseSurface.tsx:388`), and the waitlist is still decided by the zip. `src/lib/metro/admission.ts` sits inside the guard's scanned surfaces and the guard stayed green on #1484's CI; `src/lib/geo` and `src/app/explore` are outside the scan, which is right since they serve open-market admission, not the waitlist [V]. Smoked: explore green again in run 45885931303 (2026-11-26, main 71107bcd), red elsewhere, not on explore [V].

criteria.text: The waitlist join is four or five screens: plans, a business page only for be-found picks, then name, zip, email and mobile on one page; staff-only, counted per market, never a member type
criteria.note: Built by #1313 (landing and one-question-per-screen journey, 2026-11-13), #1314 (the entry keeps name, mobile, zip and plans; staff-only column grant) and #1321 (four or five screens, 2026-11-14), behind the `waitlist-journey` flag, builders only; the public front page is unchanged [V PR bodies, `registry.ts:27`]. Checked no: the never-a-member-type half is guarded (the one whole marker, `[guards F076.3]` in `tests/f076-never-rules.test.ts`, covers the no-role-column half, which is why this is a behavior and not a launch-blocking invariant); two partials cover the column grant (`waitlist-join.test.ts:180`, `waitlist-journey-join.test.ts:94`); the journey's screens, order and branching are tested in `journey.test.ts` and `JourneyScreen.test.tsx` without a marker [V]. Reviewed yes: all three carry `Reviewed by: a second session` with a GitHub review. Shipped yes: Deploy health green on ec833ea6, 2eeb17ac, 233bd971 [V]. Smoked unknown: no smoke run has opened `/join/waitlist` (flagged, builders only); run 44594715209 covered explore, page and you. The PM walks it live (#1313 review steps). Filed #1376 (check, launch-blocking, Beta).

criteria.text: The waitlist entry records make or find, neither pre-selected; no role is stored on the member
criteria.note: Overtaken by the scenario's criterion 3 and the 2026-11-12 and 2026-11-14 rulings ([replaces 2026-11-12: ... what the person plans to do ...], 'no make-or-find question'): the entry no longer records a make-or-find role; it records plans and being-found details (new criterion 3). The never-a-member-type half carries over to criterion 3 (`[guards F076.3]` still scans for a role, creator or patron column on a person table). Shown, not counted.

criteria.text: The make-or-find answer is discarded when the market opens
criteria.note: Overtaken by the same rulings: there is no role to discard; the whole entry, answers included, is deleted once the invite is sent (criterion 15; `open-market.ts`, #1314 body) [V]. Shown, not counted.

criteria.text: One person counts once in one market, whether they signed up or only left an email
criteria.note: Member row unique by `member_id`; address row unique by `lower(email)`; a member who had left an address is folded into the member row (#763, #613) [V handlers]. `[guards F076.4]` x2 in `waitlist-join.test.ts` plus a partial for the reverse order in `waitlist-join-anonymous.test.ts` [V]. Reviewed no: #86, #191, #197 carry no `Reviewed by:`. Shipped unknown: no Deploy health run for 640e1fc2 (#86); 6df9b932, 0ac5c54f, 0ae50d98 green [V]. Smoked unknown: the anonymous panel is reached only by picking a waiting market, which no smoke does. Since #1313 and #1314 the journey handler also counts one row per email per market, `[guards F076.4]` in `waitlist-journey-join.test.ts:54` [V].

criteria.text: Changing the market moves the count; neither double-counted nor stranded
criteria.note: Both handlers update the row and move the counter in one transaction [V]. `[guards F076.5]` in `f076-criteria.test.ts` runs the move through both ways of joining (mocked database; mutants run by hand, #766) [V]. Built by #86, #191, #197: no `Reviewed by:`; Deploy health unknown for #86. Smoked unknown (as 4). The journey handler moves the count on a zip change too, `[guards F076.5]` in `waitlist-journey-join.test.ts:73` [V].

criteria.text: Creator and patron counts are stored separately and readable apart
criteria.note: `metro_polygons.creator_count` and `patron_count` (and the same on `markets`) [V migrations]. `[guards F076.6]` in `f076-criteria.test.ts` for both paths [V]. Built by #86; reviewed no, shipped unknown, smoked unknown (as 4).

criteria.text: After joining, a popup shows a count and a message, for everyone, from the cache
criteria.note: Built since 2026-10-23: #1031 (bug #686, #1030) gives `getMetroWaitingCounts` a cookie-free `createAnonClient()` inside `unstable_cache`, so the read no longer throws; both join actions call `waitingCountFor` and the panel opens `MetroStandingDialog` [V src/lib/metro/waitlist-counts.ts lines 95-109, MetroNotCoveredPanel.tsx]. Not reproduced on production today [A]. Checked no: `[guards F076.7 partial]` covers the signed-in popup only; the anonymous popup tests in `metro-waitlist-anonymous-actions.test.ts` and #1031's `waitlist-counts.test.ts` (seen failing before the fix) carry no marker [V]. Reviewed no: #217, #764 no first-pass review; #1031 `Reviewed by: build lane`, no GitHub review [V]. Shipped: Deploy health green on a3faf37c, 88724880 and 40096159765 on 0dbf6d8a [V]. Smoked unknown: the popup needs a join, which no smoke does. #686 and #1030 closed 2026-10-24. Filed #1118 (check, launch-blocking, Beta). The journey's finish screen shows the area and its waiting count (#1313 body) [V].

criteria.text: One combined number against the combined target, the same figure everywhere
criteria.note: Built since 2026-10-23: one cached read (`waitingCountByMetro`) serves the popup and the area picker, which Explore now receives instead of an empty map (#1031; `load.ts` lines 95 and 123) [V]. The target is `COMBINED_TARGET = 300` (50 + 250) [V waitlist-standing.ts]; the scenario no longer names 300; the floors are now 100 makers and 1,000 supporters (criterion 10b, #1377), so the target follows that change. Checked no: `[guards F076.8 partial]` covers the signed-in popup; the picker's ordering tests in `feed-metro-sort.test.ts` carry no marker [V]. Reviewed no (#217, #764, #1031 as 7). Shipped: a3faf37c, 88724880, 0dbf6d8a green [V]. Smoked: smoke-live run 45885931303 (2026-11-26, main 71107bcd) opened explore as signed-out, stranger, member and operator, HTTP 200 and passed; red elsewhere (page and page-business timeouts, two sign-in stalls), not on explore; it loads the route, it does not open the picker [V].

criteria.text: The message says what is still needed and never a date, a timeline or a promise
criteria.note: `standingMessage` in `waitlist-standing.ts`; `[guards F076.9]` asserts no date or promise wording [V]. #1038 (2026-10-24, F103.4) swapped 'metro' for 'area' inside the message, no other change; the PM looks at it live. Draft PR #684 holds other wording (do not merge). Built by #86; reviewed no, shipped unknown (#86), smoked unknown (as 4).

criteria.text: A market is eligible to open only when both floors are met separately; the combined total alone is not enough
criteria.note: Split 2026-10-30: 10a is the two-gate rule, 10b the numbers. `metroStanding` gates on creators and patrons separately; `[guards F076.10]` as one table [V waitlist-standing.ts, .test.ts]. Built by #86; reviewed no, shipped unknown, smoked unknown.

criteria.text: The floors are 100 makers and 1,000 supporters (F118)
criteria.note: The scenario's criterion 10 now carries the numbers (the 2026-10-26 ruling in F118 [replaces 2026-09-14: 50 creators and 250 patrons]); it was retired in the last report while the scenario still said 50/250. Not built [V]: `creator_threshold` and `patron_threshold` default to 50 and 250 and `COMBINED_TARGET = 300` (`waitlist-standing.ts:16`). Filed #1377 (launch-blocking, Beta); #1101 item 4 carries the same change inside a bundle. Rechecked 2026-11-27 [V]: `COMBINED_TARGET = 300` still at `waitlist-standing.ts:16`; nothing merged for #1377.

criteria.text: Thresholds are configurable per market without a migration or a deploy
criteria.note: Threshold columns on `metro_polygons` and `markets` (defaults 50/250, an UPDATE changes them); `[guards F076.11]` scans for hard-coded thresholds and reads the column defaults [V]. Built by #86; reviewed no, shipped unknown, smoked unknown.

criteria.text: Opening a market is deliberate; crossing the threshold never opens it
criteria.note: Since #1056 the one writer of `is_open` is `scripts/market/open-market.ts`, run by a person; F118's daily round (`town_mark_ready`, #1093) marks a town ready and logs an Issue, never opens [V]. `[guards F076.12]` scans src, scripts and every migration except the two seeds and allow-lists only the opener [V tests/f076-never-rules.test.ts lines 128-152]. Built by #86 (no run), #1056 (66e50b13 green); reviewed no; smoked unknown.

criteria.text: Joining the waitlist creates no account and no password
criteria.note: `metro.waitlist_join_anonymous` and `MetroNotCoveredPanel`: address and role only, no password or name, one tap; since #1031 the standing popup follows instead of a page error [V]. `[guards F076.13]` drives the panel and asserts the exact call [V]. Built by #197, #198 (no `Reviewed by:`); Deploy health green on 0ac5c54f, 8ad3ee56. Smoked unknown: the panel is reached only by picking a waiting market, which no smoke does. The journey handler creates a waitlist row and nothing else (#1313), and `[guards F076.18]` scans the journey files for Twilio, Lookup, Verify, a code or `signInWithOtp` [V].

criteria.text: The response is identical whether or not the address was already there, the number included
criteria.note: The result carries no changed or created flag; the number is the cached figure (one hour), never a function of the submission, and since #1031 it actually reaches the screen [V]. `[guards F076.14]` runs the handler on a real database for a new, a repeated and another known address and expects byte-identical results, and scans that no other code reads the live counters [V]. Reviewed no (#197, #217); shipped yes (0ac5c54f, a3faf37c, 0dbf6d8a); smoked unknown (as 13).

criteria.text: An address is used only to say the market opened, then discarded
criteria.note: Built since 2026-10-23: #1056 adds `scripts/market/open-market.ts`, which opens the market, sends the ruled words ('SocialUs is open in {market}. See what's going on.') to each address on the landing list through the reminders' Resend sender, deletes each address only after its message went out, and retries failed sends on a re-run [V src/lib/market/open-market.ts]. Nothing can go out yet: `FOLLOW_EMAIL_FROM` (a verified sending domain) is not set in production, an account step for the PM [V PR body; A today]. Checked no: `[guards F076.15 partial: the send and the discard, against a fake database]`; no standing guard that nothing else reads `metro_waitlist.email` [V grep]. Reviewed no (`Reviewed by: build lane`). Shipped: 66e50b13 and 55fb92f2 (#1093 touched the script) green [V]. Smoked unknown: not a route. #616 open (launch-blocking, Beta): the domain step. Filed #1118 (check, launch-blocking, Beta). Rechecked 2026-11-27 [V]: #616 is unchanged in substance and was moved to the 'Sacramento opening 2027-01-06' milestone; `FOLLOW_EMAIL_FROM` still the PM's step [A].

Checked: `[guards F076.17]` in `src/actions/metro/waitlist-journey-join.test.ts:45` ('joins the zip's market even when that market is marked open'), whole, red under mutation per the PR body [V]. Reviewed yes (#1313, two second-session reviews). Shipped yes (ec833ea6 green). Smoked unknown (flagged journey, not a smoke route). The journey is behind the flag until the PM walks it.

criteria.text: Email and mobile are asked and neither is checked at join; the contact page says why; the invite is by email; the checks happen at sign-up (F081)
criteria.note: The journey's contact page asks name, zip, email and mobile last with the why-phone line, and the handler stores them unchecked (#1313, #1314, #1321) [V PR bodies]. Checked: `[guards F076.18]` in `tests/f076-never-rules.test.ts:224` scans every journey file (`src/app/join`, `src/components/waitlist`, `src/lib/waitlist`, the action and handler) for Twilio, Lookup, Verify, a code or `signInWithOtp` [V]. The invite goes by email through `open-market.ts` (#1056); nothing can send until `FOLLOW_EMAIL_FROM` is set, an account step for the PM [A]. Reviewed yes (#1313, #1314, #1321). Shipped yes (green on ec833ea6, 2eeb17ac, 233bd971). Smoked unknown (as 3).

criteria.text: Metros are ordered by how many people are waiting
criteria.note: Struck 2026-10-11 (F103 ruling, in the scenario): there is no list of markets to order, since the zip decides. The area picker still lists metros and, since #1031, orders the waiting ones by the cached figure; the surviving rule, that no surface reads the live counters, is under criteria 8 and 14. Shown, not counted.
